title: Chicken Noodle Soup – A Tribute to His Roots
story:
Sometimes, a song stays with you for years because it reminds you of where everything began. For j-hope, **Chicken Noodle Soup** was one of those songs.

A SONG FROM HIS EARLY DANCE YEARS

When he was young and first learning to dance, he often danced to the original **2006 track by Webstar and Young B**. The song became part of his early dance memories, connecting him to the music and culture that had inspired him as a young dancer in Gwangju.

Years later, while working on his first mixtape, **Hope World**, j-hope wanted to include his own version of Chicken Noodle Soup. He felt that the track represented an important part of who he was: his love of dance and the music that had shaped him. The collaboration he originally imagined did not come together at the time, so the song remained unreleased.

But he never forgot about it.

THE COLLABORATION WITH BECKY G

On **September 27, 2019**, j-hope finally released **Chicken Noodle Soup featuring American singer Becky G**. The two artists brought their own languages and musical identities to the track. j-hope wrote and performed his verses in Korean, while Becky G contributed Spanish lyrics. Together, they created a multilingual hip-hop song that celebrated their shared childhood connection to the original track.

BRINGING THE DANCE TO LIFE

The music video was just as special. More than **50 dancers from different countries** joined j-hope and Becky G, bringing the choreography to life. The video reimagined the original dance while adding their own energy and style. j-hope also took part in shaping the concept and creative details of the video, wanting to capture the joyful atmosphere on set.

For him, the collaboration was about more than releasing a new song. It was a way to return to his beginnings, celebrate the dance culture that had inspired him, and share that part of his story with the world.

From a young boy dancing in Gwangju to an international collaboration with Becky G, the journey had come full circle.

Sometimes, the songs that take us furthest are the ones that bring us back to where we started.
